# Sort-key escaping probe

Every printable ASCII character except the space, each as the whole sort
key of an entry of its own. A sort key travels the same channel an entry
key does, so the same characters need the same mechanisms — with one
character that only matters here: `@` is what the LaTeX back-end writes
between a sort key and the text it files, so an `@` the author writes must
still reach the index tool quoted. Generated to cover the range by
construction rather than by recall.

A literal `!` is written `!!`, since a lone `!` is a level separator; `\\`
and `\"` are the two Pandoc consumes a backslash level from.
